  (function () {
    const btn = document.getElementById('langBtn');
    const menu = document.getElementById('langMenu');
    if (!btn || !menu) return;

    function close() {
      menu.classList.add('hidden');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    function toggle() {
      const isOpen = !menu.classList.contains('hidden');
      if (isOpen) close();
      else {
        menu.classList.remove('hidden');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    }

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      toggle();
    });

    // סגירה בלחיצה מחוץ לתפריט/כפתור

      if (menu.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
      if (menu.contains(e.target) || btn.contains(e.target)) return;
      close();
    });

    // סגירה ב-Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
    });
  })();

<script>
(function(){
  const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.rb-latest-rotating-card'));
  if (!cards.length) return;

  const perPage = 4;
  let page = 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(cards.length / perPage));
  const counter = document.querySelector('[data-rb-latest-counter]');
  const nextBtn = document.querySelector('[data-rb-latest-next]');
  const prevBtn = document.querySelector('[data-rb-latest-prev]');
  let timer = null;

  function render(){
    const start = page * perPage;
    const end = start + perPage;

    cards.forEach(function(card, index){
      const visible = index >= start && index < end;
      card.classList.toggle('rb-latest-hidden', !visible);
      card.classList.toggle('rb-latest-show', visible);
    });

    if (counter && totalPages > 1) {
      counter.textContent = (page + 1) + ' / ' + totalPages;
    }
  }

  function go(direction){
    page = (page + direction + totalPages) % totalPages;
    render();
  }

  function restart(){
    if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
    if (totalPages > 1) timer = setInterval(function(){ go(1); }, 5000);
  }

  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ go(1); restart(); });
  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ go(-1); restart(); });

  render();
  restart();
})();
</script>
